name: colo-design
description: Screen design in a chat for people with zero developer tooling knowledge. Connect your team's repo, ask for a screen in words, a pasted image, or an attached document, verify it against a live preview of the real app, and hand it off to developers. Each user runs their own daemon and signs in with their own Claude subscription.

scripts.dev:daemon: node scripts/free-port.mjs daemon && COLO_DESIGN_DEV_AGENTS=1 pnpm --filter @colo-design/daemon dev
